annotations.title: MASTER: check a result before the owner sees it

description: Run your result through MASTER before it goes to the owner: forbidden words, names outside the rider, a foreign language, placeholders (coming soon, TBD, WIP), a foreign brand, a promise without a number. Returns ok and naruszenia with fragment, rule and hint. MASTER does not rewrite your text: fix it yourself and check again. Two failed checks in a row are written to the LEDGER.

text.description: Your result for the owner, exactly as you would send it (up to 20000 characters).

name: master_check
